analogy.rationale: Cholinergic receptors (muscarinic and nicotinic) are largely absent from these cell lines, so cholinergic agonists produce little transcriptional response; the closest analogs are other acetylcholine-receptor-targeting classes that share the same near-silent profile, with acetylcholine receptor agonist being the most similar.
